text_block_list.text:
Stopping by a shopping mall on the way 
back from our outing, I could hear the 
excited cheers of a crowd at an event.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Could someone pick one card they like from 
these— You over there, little pony, would 
you mind helping me out?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, m-me?! Hyaiee...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmm, a magic show, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nothing. Just—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's actually quite a bit of 
mathematical logic behind card tricks like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, let's take a look around 
a bit!

text_block_list.text:
She didn't reply, but she did stop in her 
tracks, so we decided to watch Fuji 
Kiseki's show from a short distance away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm glad you came to watch. Did you 
enjoy it?
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear it ♪ I spotted a familiar 
face, so I ended up getting a bit carried 
away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Judging by Shakur's reaction, it seems I 
might at least get a passing grade?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad. The packet switch was natural, 
and your misdirection was practically 
professional.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing? Just thought you seemed 
awfully knowledgeable about it. ...Hey, 
Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to perform in a show with 
me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!? How the hell did it end up like 
that!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I've been wondering how I can 
take my current show to the next level.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If someone smart and logical like you were 
by my side, I think it would add such a 
wonderful spice to things!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No. There's nothing in it for me.
choice_data_list: Maybe you should invite someone else...

text_block_list.text:
Appearing in a show unrelated to racing 
would be nothing more than pure noise to 
Air Shakur. Just as I was thinking there 
must be someone better suited—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then could you at least help me brainstorm 
ideas for a new magic trick?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? In the first place, it's not like 
I'm some magic expert or anything..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even just getting a fresh perspective 
would be huge. I want to breathe new life 
into the show —I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Aaargh, damn it. Stop gradually lowering 
your demands to feel out a compromise. 
It's annoying."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If you're insistin' that much, 
I'll start thinkin' about it now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? "Right now"...?

True to his word, Air Shakur managed to 
improvise a whole magic trick right then 
and there—!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—With this, you can move cards to any spot 
in the three card rows.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Three rows make base 3, four rows make 
base 4. It's a simple mechanism to convert 
positional data into numbers... Well, you 
don't really need to understand the math 
part.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
As long as you follow the steps, you won't 
mess up. Math is often used for this kind 
of foolproof magic—magic that doesn't rely 
on sleight of hand, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Pass the right arguments, get the right 
result. Just like a properly written 
program.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! The steps are so simple, yet 
the result is spectacular. I'm getting so 
excited thinking about how to stage this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me you just came up with 
this on the spot?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It ain't really no big deal. Anyone could 
do this once they know the trick—
choice_data_list: Does that mean even I can make it?
You mean I can make one too?
Still, making that on the spot is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It ain't really no big deal. Anyone could 
do this once they know the trick—
choice_data_list: Does that mean even I can make it?
You mean I can make one too?
Still, making that on the spot is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see! Indeed, if you can make them 
yourself, you can evolve your shows 
however you like♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur, if you're up for it, would you 
mind being our magic teacher?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Me, a teacher? As if... You gotta be 
kidding.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Besides, even if the underlying 
logic was complex, the results shown were 
simple and easy to understand.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I really think you'd be great on the 
performing side too. If you ever get 
interested in doing shows, just let me 
know—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ridiculous... No way in hell I'm hanging 
out with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out. Just so you know, I'm not 
doing any more favors for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Enough—leave me alone.

Air Shakur walked away coldly. Seeing how 
difficult yet brilliantly capable she was, 
I wondered what I could possibly do for 
her.
